fusions.name: Snap Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a fast shot that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Emptied Cylinder
fusions.desc: Fires 6 shots in one burst, fanned slightly apart, each of which deals 8 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Itchy Trigger Finger
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Muzzle Velocity
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 6% sooner.
